Flat loader behavior, relocation application, compression handling and build-date semantics
Flex proportion period transitions, decay, ratio computation and underlying per-CPU add

findings.text: Fallback synchronous firmware lookup and load interfaces exist but are unavailable: name lookup for a device, direct lookup, platform lookup, plain nowarn lookup, full buffer load and partial buffer load with offset all signal invalid argument and produce no firmware object.

Fallback asynchronous firmware interfaces exist but are unavailable: both nowait forms signal invalid argument without invoking completion, while cancel and release are silent no-ops with no state change.
Fallback firmware upload management signals unavailability on registration with an invalid-argument error pointer and treats unregistration as a silent no-op.

Flat executable header layout opens with magic plus version, then entry offset and data bounds with bss end where the tail between data end and bss end is bss, then stack size, then relocation start and count, then flags and build date, ending with reserved zero filler.
Flat format versions are numeric facts: current version equals four and old version equals two.
Flat flag bits are numeric facts: RAM load equals 1, GOT PIC equals 2, full gzip equals 4, data-only gzip for execute in place equals 8, kernel trace equals 16.
Old flat relocation kinds are numeric facts: text equals zero, data equals one, bss equals two.

Old flat version-two relocation record is a union offering either a raw value view or a bitfield view with a wide signed offset and a narrow type selector, with field order swapped between little and big endian bitfield configurations.
Flexible proportion global state holds a per-CPU event count for the current period, a current period identifier, and a sequence counter coordinating period transitions.
Flexible proportion local per-CPU state holds a local event counter, the period of last update, and a raw spinlock.
Local proportion lock guards period and numerator updates, and the single-event increment path runs with interrupts masked around the underlying per-CPU add.
Proportion fraction scale is a numeric fact: shift equals ten and base equals one shifted by that amount, namely 1024.
Checked string length interfaces enforce readability against known object size, bypass checking when size is unknown, otherwise bound the scan and report overflow through the fortify failure path.

Checked string copy and concatenation family is provided as externally visible overloadable inline interfaces with object-size annotations, covering bounded copy, concatenation with available size, unbounded append, counted append and unbounded copy, all delegating to an underlying operation after validation.

Checked memory search and duplication family is provided with object-size annotations, covering scan, search, inverse search and allocation-backed duplication, delegating to underlying or real operations after validation, with duplication also exposed through an allocation-hook wrapper.

Fortify memory copy and set validation combines static and dynamic enforcement: constant sizes allow static overflow diagnostics for enclosing object and field sizes, dynamic sizes trigger failure when exceeding known remaining size, and field-spanning writes produce a one-time warning while still performing the copy.

Any checked string or memory operation whose required length exceeds the known destination or source capacity invokes the fortify failure path rather than performing an out-of-bounds access; unknown sizes bypass and truncation semantics preserve the required-length return where applicable.

Fortify direction tags are numeric facts: read equals zero and write equals one, with reason codes packing function selector shifted by one plus direction, and helpers extracting direction and function parts.
Fortify function identity enumeration covers the checked string and memory family plus an unknown sentinel, with generated per-function identifiers derived from a common prefix.

Underlying memory and string primitives resolve either to sanitizer variants or to compiler builtins depending on configuration, and the unsafe copy macro forwards directly to the selected copy primitive while accepting a justification argument.

Object-size annotation and compile-time string handling provide position markers for dynamic or static size passing, a warn-once helper, an always-inline overloadable marker with rename support, and a compile-time length probe that yields unknown unless object size and terminator are statically known.

Active freezer configuration exposes a freezing query that consults a global active flag before a slow path, and a try-to-freeze entry that may sleep, skips when not freezing, validates lock state for freezable tasks and enters the refrigerator.

Disabled freezer configuration is inert: freezing and frozen queries are always false, refrigerator and thaw helpers do nothing, try-to-freeze reports false, set-freezable does nothing, and freeze requests for processes and kernel threads signal not supported while thaw-all helpers do nothing.
Firmware table parsing exposes callback types for ACPI subtable entries, one plain and one carrying an additional caller argument.
Header inclusion guards define unique macros preventing multiple inclusion for flat, flex proportions, fortify string, floating point, freezer and firmware table headers.
